# Tymor 1.2.1
## ✨ What's new
- Give your snowman a Classic, Sunny, Wink, Sleepy, Joyful, or Surprised face in Winter settings. Choose Mix to shuffle your favorites as you build new snowmen.
## ⚡ Improvements
- Choose which preset colors to mix for top hats and scarves independently. Keep two to alternate between them, or leave one selected to use it every time. Custom colors are still available as a fixed choice.

# Tymor 1.2.0
## ✨ What's new
- Choose between the classic decorated Christmas tree and the new Snowy Spruce in Winter settings. - Penguin chicks visit in flocks, leaving footprints as they waddle through the snow. They belly-slide past one another and hop on and off the Dock. Click a walking chick and it waves hello. - When the snowplow approaches, chicks turn and slide out of its path or take shelter on the Dock. If the plow blocks their way down, they line up on the edge until it passes. - Choose how many penguins visit in Winter settings. Turn on **Automatic penguin visits** or select **Bring Penguins Now** to call the flock.
## ⚡ Improvements
- Snow along the bottom of the screen has gentler ripples for a smoother belly slide over the drifts.

# Tymor 1.1.8
## ✨ What's new
- Dress your snowman in a matching crown and ribbon. Choose from five top hat palettes, starting with Midnight & Slate, or use the color wheel to pick both colors yourself. - Choose a solid Cardinal scarf or one of four striped designs, including Peppermint and Cocoa & Clementine. You can also pick your own main yarn and stripe colors. - Mix hat and scarf colors independently. Click either shuffle button again to try another pairing in the preview. Each snowman on the Dock keeps its own mix. - Choose your snowplow in Winter settings. The new Vintage Alpine Groomer joins the original Amber Ridge Groomer, with artwork for both in the style picker.
## ⚡ Improvements
- A larger snowman preview makes ribbons and scarf stripes easier to see. Its carrot, branches, and scarf now use the same shapes as the snowman you build on the Dock. - The top hat has a gently tilted crown and a rounded brim that sits more naturally on the snowman’s head. - Winter settings now group Santa, the Yeti, and Christmas trees under **Visitors & Gifts**. Settings search opens the relevant winter tab.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Fixed a sliver of snow showing above the top hat’s brim and a blue oval appearing between the snowballs in the settings preview.
